summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD joint statistical release on New Residential Construction for August 2022, issued September 20, 2022. It provides Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for total U.S. housing starts (1,575,000) and completions (1,342,000) for August 2022, compared to revised July 2022 figures (Starts: 1,404,000; Completions: 1,419,000). Tables 3a and 5a detail monthly history through August 2022. This document supplies the initial data for the task's start window (2022/08), enabling evaluation of the month-over-month condition, though later reports in the collection may contain revised August figures that would take precedence per task instructions.

The text specifies September starts at 1,439,000 (decreasing from revised August 1,566,000) and completions at 1,427,000 (increasing from revised August 1,345,000).
